entities.name: Kinesis (input event stream)
entities.rationale: Top-left icon labeled KINESIS at approx (225,68). Receives 'account updated' events from the upstream account aggregation service. Not inside any container box.

entities.name: Lambda (lean batching function)
entities.rationale: Top-center icon labeled LAMBDA at (309,68). Triggered by Kinesis, queries RDS for transactions, batches them and publishes to SQS. Not inside any container.

entities.name: RDS (raw transactions)
entities.rationale: Top-right icon labeled RDS at (393,68). Stores raw transactions written by the other aggregation service; queried by the first Lambda. Has a curved incoming arrow from an off-board source. Not inside any container.

entities.name: SQS (transaction batch queue)
entities.rationale: Center icon labeled SQS at (310,139). Receives batches of transaction descriptions from first Lambda and fans out to processing Lambdas. Not inside any container.

entities.name: Lambda (NLP processing)
entities.rationale: Icon labeled LAMBDA at (310,209). Multiple arrows from SQS indicate fan-out of many concurrent Lambdas doing NLP parsing (ANTLR). Not inside any container.

entities.name: RDS (processed transactions)
entities.rationale: Bottom-left icon labeled RDS at (249,262). Stores enriched/processed transactions with model version. Not inside any container.

entities.name: Kinesis (output event stream)
entities.rationale: Bottom-right icon labeled KINESIS at approx (370,262). Receives completion events for downstream consumers. Not inside any container.

entities.name: Account aggregation service
entities.rationale: Not drawn as an icon; implied by arrows entering from off-board into Kinesis (left) and into RDS (top curved arrow). Transcript describes an upstream service that scrapes bank data, writes to RDS and publishes events to Kinesis.

visual_connections.description: Arrow entering from the left into Kinesis: account-updated event published to the stream.
Arrow from Kinesis to top Lambda: event with account ID triggers the Lambda.
Arrow from RDS pointing to top Lambda: Lambda reads transactions via SQL query.
Curved arrow from off-board above into RDS: other service writes raw bank transactions to RDS.
Arrow down from top Lambda to SQS: publishes batches of transaction descriptions.
Multiple fanned arrows from SQS down to the second Lambda: fan-out to many processing Lambdas.
Arrow down-left from Lambda to RDS: writes enriched transactions with model version.
Arrow down-right from Lambda to Kinesis: publishes processing-complete event.
